intro: Crown of the Earth is a Darnassus quest in which adventurers deliver purified Moonwell Remnants to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Taking place inside the Temple of the Moon, the encounter reveals the sacred significance of Elune's waters and the growing political tension between Tyrande and Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.
Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.
She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.
I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.
Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.
Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
